capabilities.name: Stable project-controlled bootstrap
current: current routing/current state/Knowledge Map are durable
capabilities.gap: Normal continuation still begins through a human/model procedure rather than an executable successor reconstruction control surface.

capabilities.name: Owner-intent / project-event interpretation
capabilities.gap: No production TaskIntent/event model or interaction entrypoint translates ordinary owner language into project-controlled semantics.

capabilities.name: Task-shaped reconstruction planner
capabilities.gap: Specification 028 requires a reconstruction planner and Research 179 accepted PKA-W0-J1, but no production reconstruction.py, reconstruct CLI, or production PKA-W0-J1 regression exists.

capabilities.name: Consequential-action authority preflight
capabilities.gap: Resolver is production code, but ordinary owner interaction does not automatically invoke it before consequential guidance/action; resolve-authority CLI promised by Specification 028 is absent.

capabilities.name: Action-contract activation and final guidance/action conformance
current: mandatory constraints activated and ordered by authority resolver
capabilities.gap: Constraint activation exists, but no general production execution-plan/final-guidance conformance stage was found that guarantees activated constraints survive into dispatched guidance/action.

capabilities.name: Known-risk / reopen-trigger activation
current: bounded experiment proved risk activation when correct task path is already invoked
capabilities.gap: No general event-to-trigger matching/activation path makes relevant risks enter reasoning from ordinary owner observations.

capabilities.name: Evolution-trigger register and trigger-state monitoring
capabilities.gap: Repository-wide deferred limitations/reopen conditions have not been extracted into a monitorable current register; current production risk index covers only declared migrated sources.

capabilities.name: Frozen-architecture evolution protocol
current: Git/history and decisions preserve prior architecture
research process can reopen architecture manually
capabilities.gap: No explicit operational classifier/routes CONFORMANCE_DEFECT vs CLARIFICATION vs AMENDMENT vs SUPERSESSION vs REOPEN with trigger evidence and required review gates.

capabilities.name: Active workstream graph and deterministic resume
capabilities.gap: Core semantics exist, but ordinary interaction/process routing does not automatically open/pause/return workstreams; many project routes remain outside migrated workstream semantics.

capabilities.name: Intent-to-process routing
current: separate mature procedures exist for research, collaboration, capture, implementation, recovery, continuity
capabilities.gap: No project-controlled router maps ordinary events to answer/discussion/research/capture/change/implementation/recovery/architecture-review/human-decision paths.

capabilities.name: Preservation routing
capabilities.gap: No general interaction layer decides whether new reasoning remains ephemeral, becomes interaction-durable evidence, enters capture/backlog/research, or updates a canonical owner.

capabilities.name: Low-friction conversation-born capture
capabilities.gap: The repository mechanism exists, but ordinary conversation has no low-friction automatic/suggested intake path and depends on collaborator/owner recognition.

capabilities.name: Non-authoritative interaction continuity envelope
current: provider-local interaction metadata exists in checkpoints/current state
capabilities.gap: No first-class envelope records unresolved non-authoritative interaction material, recoverability, return condition, pending capture/review, and last durable receipt.

capabilities.name: Context-window rollover / chat interruption recovery
capabilities.gap: Procedure remains human/collaborator-driven and does not automatically preserve unresolved interaction-local state or initiate a continuation receipt.

capabilities.name: Break-glass / degraded-mode operational recovery
capabilities.gap: No project-level incident classifier/router automatically moves a failed primary path to an independent recovery channel while preserving parent-workstream continuation.

capabilities.name: Collaboration-mode and collaborator routing
capabilities.gap: Policies exist, but no event/consequence/novelty-based control surface reliably decides when Claude, Codex, Claude Code, or no second model should be used. Owner reminders still materially influence activation.

capabilities.name: Review obligations, gates, and downstream impact
capabilities.gap: Cross-thread dependency/downstream-impact discovery, generated inbox consistency, explicit review-obligation fields, and stale obligation checks remain procedural/open.

capabilities.name: Codex bounded implementation routing and transport
current: manual owner relay is accepted default
capabilities.gap: The control plane should be able to recommend/select the bounded implementation workflow, but direct automated Codex dispatch is not required for correctness.

capabilities.name: Git branch lifecycle and publication policy
current: branch state is preserved in workstream/current routing
capabilities.gap: No governed create/continue/rotate/merge/archive/retire policy, publication cadence, local-only exception contract, unpublished-commit pressure detection, or cleanup evidence policy.

capabilities.name: GitHub CI evidence publication integration
capabilities.gap: Local governed validation is not yet systematically bound/published to exact GitHub commits as project-control evidence.

capabilities.name: Reconstruction-quality and activation observability
current: qualification experiments measure bounded reads and outcomes
capabilities.gap: No routine production reconstruction receipt reports what was traversed, activated, left latent, or missed; no live activation quality metric exists.

capabilities.name: Architecture self-observation / activation-miss recording
current: new Chat 27 evidence packet preserves one live miss
capabilities.gap: No operational event type or evidence path automatically records activation misses, routing misses, repeated exceptions, or owner-reminder dependencies for later architecture evaluation.

capabilities.name: Active-surface pressure and recurring consolidation
capabilities.gap: No integrated production pressure monitor currently opens governed consolidation/review work from routing payload growth, capture age, fan-out, repeated correction, or stale summary signals.

capabilities.name: Provider/tool capability drift monitoring
current: provider portability was qualified at architecture level
capabilities.gap: Monitoring remains distributed/manual; control-plane behavior must not assume optional provider/tool capabilities without current probes.

capabilities.name: Optional direct-Codex liveness/writer/task recovery
current: manual relay + native Codex Remote accepted
capabilities.gap: Autonomous assistant wakeup, active-turn writer transfer, and direct task recovery remain intentionally optional unless direct orchestration becomes a first-order requirement.

capabilities.name: Cross-client spectator/steer/thread-history orchestration
current: some App Server capabilities are researched
capabilities.gap: Same-turn steering, spectator synchronization, long-thread APIs, and multi-agent lineage are not required for the core owner-intent control plane yet.

capabilities.name: Host capability authority taxonomy
capabilities.gap: Other host-resource classes remain open and must not inherit broad authority implicitly.

capabilities.name: Open backlog / open-question relevance activation
capabilities.gap: Relevant deferred architecture/open questions can remain practically invisible unless a collaborator chooses to inspect them; no task/event relevance activation is enforced.

capabilities.name: Semantic/hierarchical retrieval beyond flat legacy Knowledge Map
current: source catalog and structural subject_index exist
T1 controlled semantic subject architecture is frozen
capabilities.gap: Production subject catalog/source-owned semantic memberships/subject_index V2 are not implemented because W5-F0 is paused; current activation still relies heavily on legacy navigation and explicit search.

capabilities.name: Operational use of successor control plane before authority switch
current: Candidate 01 can represent its own migration in shadow and current authority remains explicit
capabilities.gap: No accepted/qualified bridge mode yet allows successor reconstruction/activation/routing to operate as a control layer over current continuity authority during W5.

capabilities.name: Specification 028 V1 command-surface completion
capabilities.gap: Specification 028 also requires equivalent resolve-authority, reconstruct, and migration-audit command surfaces. None is currently exposed. Reconstruction/authority commands are directly relevant to the bootstrap control plane; migration-audit must be scheduled before W5 acceptance/cutover qualification.
